valaire.bio: Montréal group VALAIRE blends electronic music, jazz, funk, hip-hop and pop in a playful, groove-heavy catalogue that evolved from the band's earlier Misteur Valaire name.

vita chambers.bio: Vancouver-born Barbadian-Canadian singer-songwriter Vita Chambers makes pop-rock and electropop, building an independent career after early major-label releases and touring with Justin Bieber.

walk off the earth.bio: Burlington, Ontario band Walk Off the Earth is a Canadian pop-rock and indie-pop group known for inventive multi-instrumental arrangements, viral performance videos and a broad international touring career.

whipped cream.bio: Toronto-born, Vancouver Island-based producer and DJ WHIPPED CREAM, born Caroline Cecil, makes bass-heavy electronic music spanning trap, house and festival-oriented club production.

wide mouth mason.bio: Saskatoon-formed Canadian blues-rock band Wide Mouth Mason has built a decades-long catalogue around dynamic guitar playing, soulful vocals and improvisational live performances.

wild strawberries.bio: Canadian husband-and-wife duo Wild Strawberries, formed by Roberta Carter-Harrison and Ken Harrison, makes moody, introspective pop-rock and alternative music through a long-running independent catalogue.

william prince.bio: Peguis First Nation singer-songwriter William Prince makes warm, resonant folk and country music built around a deep baritone, spare arrangements and reflective storytelling.

wintersleep.bio: Nova Scotia band Wintersleep makes expansive Canadian indie rock that combines atmospheric guitars, rhythmic experimentation and melodic songwriting across a catalogue dating to the early 2000s.

witch prophet.bio: Toronto-based Ethiopian-Eritrean artist Witch Prophet, born Etmet Musa, blends experimental R&B, soul, jazz, hip-hop and electronic music with layered vocals and self-produced, identity-driven songwriting.

wolf castle.bio: Mi'kmaq rapper and producer Wolf Castle is a New Brunswick artist whose energetic hip-hop mixes sharp bars, self-produced beats and Indigenous perspective.

wondagurl.bio: Toronto-born, Brampton-raised producer, songwriter and record executive WondaGurl is one of Canada's most influential contemporary hip-hop producers, with credits for Jay-Z, Travis Scott, Rihanna and Drake.

wordburglar.bio: Halifax-born, Toronto-based rapper Wordburglar, born Sean Jordan, makes upbeat alternative hip-hop built around dense wordplay, humour, pop-culture references and his work with the Backburner collective.
